standard.summary: 控制 logit_normal 时间步采样的 sigmoid 缩放系数，决定采样分布的集中程度（宽/窄）。
standard.effect: 值越大，采样越集中于中等噪声步（中频特征）；值越小，采样分布越宽（覆盖更多极端时间步）。
standard.whenToUse: 配合 anima_weighting_scheme=logit_normal 使用，通过调整此值控制训练的"频率偏好"。
standard.avoidWhen: 不使用 logit_normal 权重方案时此参数无效。

standard_en.summary: The sigmoid scale used by logit_normal timestep sampling; it decides how tightly the sampling distribution concentrates (wide or narrow).
standard_en.effect: Larger values concentrate sampling on mid-noise steps (mid-frequency features); smaller values widen the distribution to cover more extreme timesteps.
standard_en.whenToUse: Together with anima_weighting_scheme=logit_normal, use this value to steer the run's frequency preference.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It has no effect when the logit_normal weighting scheme is not in use.

advanced.principle: 时间步采样：t ~ sigmoid(σ × N(0,1))，σ 即 sigmoid_scale。σ 越大，采样越集中于 t=0.5（中等噪声）；σ=1 时接近均匀分布。
advanced.tradeoffs: 集中采样中等噪声步有助于学习语义级特征，但可能欠拟合极端（纯噪声 / 纯干净）时间步的分布，影响全局结构或细节极端情况。

advanced_en.principle: Timestep sampling: t ~ sigmoid(σ × N(0,1)), where σ is sigmoid_scale. Larger σ concentrates sampling around t=0.5 (medium noise); σ=1 approaches uniform.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Concentrating on medium-noise steps helps learn semantic-level features but may underfit the extremes (pure noise / pure clean), affecting global structure or extreme detail cases.
